cohort: 127 patients who had a previous cesarean section and were admitted to hospital during the active or second stage of labor
finding: Advanced cervical opening, effacement, gravidity, parity, and prior vaginal delivery were factors associated with successful vaginal birth after cesarean section.
mod_finding: This study investigated factors associated with successful vaginal birth after cesarean section (VBAC) and found that advanced cervical opening, effacement, gravidity, parity, and prior vaginal delivery were associated with VBAC success.
